items.brief: New hires say they get several urgent tasks at once and do not know which one to do first.

side: Month-end close moved up a week, so I handed out tasks without saying which come first. My fault. I can send a ranked list every Monday morning.

items.brief: New hires say questions to you can wait a day or more, mostly in the afternoons.
New hires say they cover tasks from people who are away and stay late to finish.

side: I cover two desks since a senior left in August, and I am on audit calls most afternoons. I can hold a fixed 30-minute question slot at 9:30 every day.

items.brief: New hires say they learn the ticket system by watching others, with no set training.

side: Shadowing was cut short by the system migration. The ticketing course restarts next Tuesday and every new hire is booked on it.

items.brief: New hires say the job is not what they were told when they were hired.

side: They were hired for reporting, but everyone starts on reconciliations for three months. Nobody told them that. I will explain the plan in their 1-on-1s.

items.brief: New hires say it is hard to reach you when you travel.

side: I am in Tokyo two weeks a month. When I am away, Kenji can answer daily questions. I had not told the new hires that.

items.brief: New hires say they eat and sit alone and are not in the team's group chat.
